returns: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Sale items are final. Start a return from the order confirmation email; return shipping is free in the US.
exchanges: Size exchanges are free and ship as soon as we receive the original item. One free exchange per order line.
shipping: Free standard shipping (3–5 business days) on orders over $75; otherwise $6.95. Express (1–2 business days) is $14.95. We ship to the US and Canada.
warranty: Footwear and outerwear carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Normal wear and tear is not covered.
gift: Gift wrap is available for $5 per item and every order can include a gift receipt with prices hidden.
price_match: We match the price of an identical in-stock item sold by us within 14 days of purchase.
